Campbell county circuit court

Address: 732 Village Hwy, Rustburg, VA 24588, United States

Phone: +14345929517

The Campbell County Circuit Court was established in 1807, the same year that Campbell County was formed from parts of Bedford County. The court has been in continuous operation since its founding, with its current courthouse building dating back to 1872.

Jurisdiction of Campbell County Circuit Court

The Campbell County Circuit Court has jurisdiction over a variety of civil and criminal cases, including but not limited to:

  • Felony criminal cases
  • Civil cases with claims of $25,000 or more
  • Divorce and child custody cases
  • Adoption cases
  • Juvenile criminal and delinquency cases
  • Probate and estate cases
  • Appeals from lower courts

Structure of Campbell County Circuit Court

The Campbell County Circuit Court consists of one judge, who is elected by the Virginia General Assembly for an eight-year term. The court also has a clerk's office, which handles administrative tasks such as filing and record-keeping.

Court Procedures in Campbell County Circuit Court

The procedures in the Campbell County Circuit Court will vary depending on the type of case being heard. In general, however, the court will follow these basic steps:

  1. Jury selection (if applicable)
  2. Opening statements by attorneys
  3. Presentation of evidence and witness testimony
  4. Closing arguments by attorneys
  5. Jury instructions (if applicable)
  6. Jury deliberation and verdict (if applicable)
  7. Sentencing (if applicable)

Filing a Case in Campbell County Circuit Court

To file a case in the Campbell County Circuit Court, you will need to fill out the appropriate forms and pay the required fees. You will also need to serve papers on the other party or parties involved in the case.

Serving Papers in Campbell County Circuit Court

Serving papers in the Campbell County Circuit Court can be done in a number of ways, including personal service, certified mail, or publication. It is important to follow the proper procedures for serving papers to ensure that the other party is properly notified of the case.

Campbell County Circuit Court Calendar

The Campbell County Circuit Court maintains a calendar of upcoming cases, which can be accessed online or in person at the courthouse. It is important to check the calendar regularly if you have a case pending in the court.

Campbell County Circuit Court Forms

The Campbell County Circuit Court provides a variety of forms for use in filing cases and other court-related matters. These forms can be accessed online or in person at the courthouse.

Campbell County Circuit Court Records

The Campbell County Circuit Court maintains records of all cases heard in the court, including case files, transcripts, and other documents. These records are generally available to the public, although some may be restricted for privacy or other reasons.

Campbell County Circuit Court Fees

The Campbell County Circuit Court charges various fees for filing cases, obtaining copies of records, and other court-related services. These fees can vary depending on the type of case and the specific service requested.

Appealing a Decision from Campbell County Circuit Court

If you are unhappy with a decision made by the Campbell County Circuit Court, you may have the option to appeal the decision to a higher court. The procedures for appealing a decision can be complex, so it is important to seek legal advice if you are considering an appeal.

Local Rules of Campbell County Circuit Court

The Campbell County Circuit Court has established local rules that govern its procedures and operations. These rules can be accessed online or in person at the courthouse.

The Campbell County Circuit Court allows individuals to search for court dockets by name through its online portal. This can be a useful tool for individuals who need to find information about a specific case or court proceeding.

The Campbell County Circuit Court maintains criminal court records for cases that fall within its jurisdiction. These records can include information about the charges, court proceedings, and outcomes of criminal cases.

The Campbell County Clerk of Courts maintains records for the Circuit Court, General District Court, and Juvenile and Domestic Relations Court. These records can be searched online or in person at the courthouse.

The Campbell County Circuit Court hears a variety of civil and criminal cases, including traffic offenses, family law matters, and felony criminal cases. Each case is assigned a docket number that can be used to track the case's progress.

Campbell County Public Records

The Campbell County Circuit Court maintains a variety of public records, including court proceedings, land records, and marriage licenses. These records can be accessed online or in person at the courthouse.

Campbell County Court Docket Online
